prompts.face/anger-full-face: Frontal clinical portrait, FACS AU4+AU5+AU7+AU23: brows drawn together and down, upper lids retracted to show sclera, lower lids tense, lips sealed in a thin line. No AU1 (inner brow raise), no AU2 (outer brow raise), no AU6 (cheek raise). Even dermatology lighting, natural skin, no makeup, visible pores. Square crop. --ar 1:1
prompts.face/fear-full-face: Frontal clinical still of a complete fear expression, 85mm lens, eye level. Full facial composite: inner brows raised and drawn together into an oblique angle (AU1+AU2+AU4), central forehead wrinkles, upper eyelids retracted exposing sclera above irises (AU5), lower eyelids tense, mouth pulled back horizontally toward the ears into an elongated slit (AU20). Pale complexion, fine sheen of perspiration, neck musculature slightly tensed. Neutral dermatology softbox illumination, unretouched skin texture, square framing. --ar 1:1
prompts.face/sadness-full-face: Frontal portrait of a complete sadness expression, 85mm lens. Oblique distress brow: inner eyebrows lifted and knit together (AU1+AU4) with central forehead wrinkles, upper eyelids relaxed or slightly hooded, bilateral downturned mouth corners (AU15), and chin boss raised with dimpled texture (AU17). Somber, soft daylight illumination, unretouched adult skin, neutral background, square crop centered on the midface. --ar 1:1
prompts.face/happiness-full-face: Frontal clinical portrait of a full Duchenne smile, 85mm portrait lens. Bilateral zygomaticus major elevation (AU12) drawing lip corners diagonally upward, lips parted exposing upper dentition (AU25), cheeks elevated, lower eyelids cushioned and raised, prominent lateral canthal crow’s feet (AU6). Relaxed forehead with zero glabellar recruitment. High color rendering index lighting, pores and skin texture visible, square crop. --ar 1:1
prompts.face/disgust-full-face: Frontal clinical still of complete disgust expression, 85mm lens. Nasal bridge heavily wrinkled with transverse furrows and flared nostrils (AU9), central upper lip lifted exposing upper teeth (AU10), lip corners pulled downward (AU15), lower lip depressed (AU16). Midface compacted vertically, eyes slightly narrowed, head slightly retracted. Neutral clinical light, detailed unretouched skin, square crop. --ar 1:1
prompts.face/surprise-full-face: Frontal clinical still of complete surprise expression, 85mm lens. Entire brow elevated into smooth high arches with transverse forehead lines (AU1+AU2), smooth glabella with no frown knit, palpebral fissures wide open exposing sclera above round pupils (AU5), mandible dropped vertically in masseter relaxation forming an open oval mouth (AU26). No horizontal mouth stretch, no cheek lift. Crisp dermatology lighting, pores intact, square framing. --ar 1:1
prompts.face/anxiety-full-face: Frontal documentary portrait of sustained anxious strain, 85mm lens. Subtle tonic upper face tension with faintly raised and knit medial brows (AU1+AU4), shallow central forehead creases, vigilant restless eyes, lips pressed together in a tight, blanched line of control (AU24), subtle masseter clench visible along the jawline. Natural diffuse lighting, unpolished realism, authentic skin pores. Square crop. --ar 1:1
prompts.face/panic-full-face: Frontal clinical portrait of acute panic, 85mm lens. Extreme facial aperture: brows elevated and strain-knit across the forehead (AU1+AU2+AU4), maximal eye widening with full supra-iris scleral display and dilated pupils (AU5), jaw dropped in a breathless air-hungry gape (AU26). Marked dermal pallor, cold perspiration sheen on forehead and upper lip. Documentary clinic lighting, unretouched skin, square framing. --ar 1:1
prompts.face/shame-full-face: Three-quarter clinical view of full shame posture and face, 85mm lens. Head pitched downward with chin sinking toward the sternum (AU54), gaze cast sharply downward with hooded eyelids (AU64), subdued lips with faintly depressed corners (AU15). Visible erythema flushing the cheeks, ears, and anterior neck. Soft natural directional light, authentic skin texture, square framing. --ar 1:1
prompts.face/pride-full-face: Portrait of full pride display, 85mm lens, camera at eye level looking up slightly. Head tilted back 15 degrees with elevated chin and long neck (AU53), balanced direct gaze, small controlled closed-lip smile with slightly lifted corners (AU12). prompts.face/contempt-full-face: Frontal clinical portrait of contempt, 85mm lens. prompts.face/awe-full-face: Frontal clinical portrait of awe, 85mm portrait lens. prompts.face/love-full-face: Frontal intimate portrait of affiliative warmth, 85mm lens.
